<!--
Made by docs/release-check/build.js from docs/release-check/checks.js: change the checks THERE and
run the build (this file, the web checklist and the printable PDF are made from it). One issue per release;
ticks save by themselves; anything that fails goes in a comment.
-->

The easier way to do this: the web checklist (steps, notes, a report Claude can read). Ask Claude for its link.
How to put the new version on a copy: [DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/jskeller29/Parent-coordinator-sheet/blob/Test-Version/DEPLOY.md), sections 1 to 3.
Test files: [test-data](https://github.com/jskeller29/Parent-coordinator-sheet/tree/Test-Version/test-data) (its README says what each one should show).
Something fails? Write it as a comment on this issue: the step, what you saw, a screenshot, and any red error from Extensions → Apps Script → **Executions**.
Checks marked _(optional)_ can wait, and _(try to break it)_ ones are extra. Do the other 55 (the essentials) before any school gets this version. Round 2: **Fixed, re-test** marks what changed since the last round.

## Part 1: Set up for testing
Make the test copies. Your live sheet is never touched.

### Before you start
_Four rules for every test copy._
- [ ] **0.1 One Google account in this browser.** Use a browser window signed in to only your school Google account (a private window where you sign in once works too). **You should see:** Only one account shows when you click your picture at the top right of Google Sheets. _Why: Several accounts in one browser can make the 🚀 App Menu slow or missing._ _Last time: Skipped_
- [ ] **0.2 Phone sync stays off on test copies.** Never turn on ⚙️ Settings → Contacts & sync → "Sync contacts to my phone every night" on a test copy. Stage 6 is the one exception, from a second Google account. A new copy starts with it off, so there is nothing to turn off: just look once after each copy's Initial Setup. **You should see:** The switch is off when you open ⚙️ Settings on a test copy. _Why: A test copy with it on would put its families into the "School Directory" label of YOUR Google Contacts every night at 10 PM. Before this version a copy took the switch from the sheet it was copied from._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.3 Never bring over from your live sheet.** When a test asks you to bring over last year's tracker, pick a test copy, never your live sheet. **You should see:** Your live sheet never asks "Keep this tracker paused?". _Why: Bringing a tracker over pauses that tracker's 10 PM rebuild. If it happens to your live sheet: open it and answer No._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.4 The test files.** Download "PC Tracker test data.zip" from the test-data folder on GitHub and unzip it. **You should see:** A folder with 1 - Student Data (ATS), 2 - Parent Square, 3 - NYCSA, 4 - Site and Class and four 5 - Your Lists files. _Last time: Works_

### 1. Make the test copies
_A TEST master (a copy of your sheet with the new version). Then 📦 Make Release Copies on it makes the other two: its Example is your fake-data copy, its Blank your test template. Your way (11/17) is fine too: when your live sheet already runs this version, skip 1.1 to 1.3, make the two copies from your live sheet in 1.4 and do 1.5 (delete the z_ files in both). Part 3's checks then run on your live sheet._
- [ ] **1.1 The TEST master.** Open your live tracker → File → Make a copy. Name it "TEST master" and the date. Open it. When it asks "Is this your MAIN sheet?", answer No, and close the New Copy Checklist. **You should see:** It has all your data and your 🐞 Debug menu. _Last time: Skipped. using my regular master sheet and just clicking make release copies from there._
- [ ] **1.2 The new version on the TEST master.** In the TEST master: Extensions → Apps Script. Follow DEPLOY.md sections 1 and 2: delete the old files it lists, paste every file from Test-Version, keep your z_ files, paste App Scripts (Mine).Json into appsscript.json. Save. **You should see:** Saving shows no red error. The file list matches the table in DEPLOY.md section 2. _Last time: Skipped. ill do the deleting in the other files themselves_
- [ ] **1.3 Setting up the TEST master.** Reload. 🚀 App Menu → 🚨 Initial Setup (a copy asks again) → approve the permissions → close the question window. Open ⚙️ Settings and look: phone sync is off (a new copy starts with it off). Close it. Then 🚀 App Menu → 🏗️ Build Sheets Only. 🐞 Debug → 🔧 Fix Dropdown Criteria, then 🐞 Debug → 🎨 Apply Sheet Style. Set the Person Spoke With dropdown by hand (DEPLOY.md section 3, step 9). **You should see:** Phone sync was already off, without you changing it. The build sidebar ticks every step. Apply Sheet Style ends with its list of things to do by hand. _Last time: Skipped_
- [ ] **1.4 The fake-data copy and the test template, in one go.** On the TEST master (never your live sheet): 🐞 Debug → 📦 Make Release Copies (Example + Blank) → Make the 2 copies. When it's done, ignore what it says to do next (Version Tracker, sharing, template folder): these are only test copies. Rename the Example "TEST fake-data copy" and the Blank "TEST template" (File → Rename), so they can't be mixed up with the real release copies in part 4. Open the TEST fake-data copy. Answer No to "Is this your MAIN sheet?". Extensions → Apps Script: delete every file starting with z_ and paste App Scripts (General).Json into appsscript.json. Save. Now it acts like a school's sheet. Reload → 🚀 App Menu → 🚨 Initial Setup → approve → close the question window. Look in ⚙️ Settings: phone sync is off. **You should see:** Both copies are made, each with a link, in the TEST master's folder. The fake-data copy has the fake students (Simpsons, Addams, Belchers…), 26 Contact Log rows, 3 events and 5 Notes, and no 🐞 Debug menu. _Why: A copy gets the code of the sheet it is made from, and your live sheet still has the old version. Part 4 runs this same menu item on your live sheet, so this also tests it. When your live sheet already has this version (your way), make the copies there: they get its code, and Make Release Copies never changes the sheet it runs on._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **1.5 The test template.** Open the TEST template. Answer No to the MAIN question, delete every z_ file, paste App Scripts (General).Json. Save. Don't run Initial Setup on it. For every new-school test, make a copy of it (File → Make a copy): that copy is what a school gets. **You should see:** Only the 👋 Welcome tab shows, and its "See an example tracker" opens the TEST fake-data copy. Extensions → Apps Script shows no file starting with z_. _Last time: Skipped. deleting all z_ code directly from both copies and not doing the test master_
- [ ] **1.6 Round 2: the fixes on your test copies.** **Fixed, re-test.** Paste these from Test-Version into the sheet you made your test copies from, then 🐞 Debug → 📦 Make Release Copies again and set the new copies up as in 1.4 and 1.5 (the easy way). Or paste them into each test copy (TEST fake-data copy, TEST template, "PC Tracker - Last year (test)"). Scripts: Core, Build, Edits, Menus, Input Data. Pages: Styles, ProgressSidebar, InputDataSidebar, MigrationUI. Save, then reload. Already done before 11/15? Paste Edits once more (the Contact Log fix in 1.7). **You should see:** Saving shows no red error. 📥 Input Data Mode opens on "Before you start". No new columns after the Contact Log's column P. _Fixed: 11/15: the build added columns after P (your note here and on 1.7). See 1.7._
- [ ] **1.7 Round 2: Person Spoke With reads the Backend.** **Fixed, re-test.** On the TEST fake-data copy and the TEST template (and later your live sheet and the master template): Contact Log → click a cell in the Person Spoke With column → Data → Data validation → the column's rule. Dropdown (from a range): ='Backend'!$CF2:$CO2 (a 2 on both ends, no $ before them). Keep Advanced → Show a warning. Done. 🚀 App Menu → 🏗️ Build Sheets Only. **You should see:** The dropdown on a few rows lists that row's student's guardians. After the build the Contact Log ends at column P: no columns after P, no checkboxes in Q or further right. Columns an older build added there (Q to AA) are deleted. Still columns after P? Tell Claude (the build's log in Extensions → Apps Script → Executions says "column D reads: ..."). You can delete them by hand: click the Q column letter, Shift-click the last one, right-click → Delete columns. The build won't add them back. _Why: The list's results used to fill Contact Log R:AA on every row, and Google then refuses "Delete table row". Now the same list sits on the hidden Backend tab, and nothing needs a column after P._ _Fixed: New in round 2 (round 1: 4.3, 4.4, 2.19). 11/15: the build added columns after P with copies of P's checkboxes (your note here); now it never adds any and deletes the empty ones._

The main test. Fake students and fake exports, so nothing real can be hurt and every answer is known.

- [ ] **8.4 Release copies.** On your live sheet: 🐞 Debug → 📦 Make Release Copies (Example + Blank). **You should see:** Two copies, "Parent Coordinator Sheet - (EXAMPLE) (date)" and "- (BLANK) (date)", a link each and one version date (it goes in the Version Tracker's column A).

- [ ] **8.8 The Version Tracker row.** Add a row: A = the version date, D "Blank Copy" = the BLANK's /copy link, E "Example" = the EXAMPLE's link, F "Document" = the User Guide (when it changed). **You should see:** Every school's tracker now offers "New Version Available".

- [ ] **8.10 The User Guide Doc.** _(optional)_ Ask Claude for the list of what changed in docs/USER_GUIDE.md, and make those changes in the Google Doc. **You should see:** The Google Doc matches this version.
- [ ] **8.11 Merge into main.** _(optional)_ Ask Claude to merge Test-Version into main. **You should see:** main is the version schools have.

This version checks for the trash, so trashing is enough._
